judgments.rationale: In F006, the Commission is not the actor; indeed, the word Commission does not appear in the text of clause (i). The exemption applies with respect to the filing of an action by an attorney general of a State. Changing the actor to the Commission is contradicted by the source text.

In C0001, the action was erroneously populated with text drawn from the condition clause ('provide the notice described in that subparagraph before the filing of the action') and the object was populated with 'Subparagraph (A)', which is the subject referring to the baseline requirement rather than an object of an action. Clearing these incorrectly populated components is a source-backed correction for an exemption record that already qualifies C0000.

source_spans.quote: Subparagraph (A) shall not apply with respect to the filing of an action by an attorney general of a State under this subsection, if the attorney general determines that it is not feasible to provide the notice described in that subparagraph before the filing of the action.
